It was designed to oppose the Calamity.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 72 |durability = 15 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Guard's Claymore}} Royal Guard's Claymores are part of the [[Royal Guard's Series]], an equipment archetype that includes the [[Royal Guard's Sword]], the [[Royal Guard's Spear]], the [[Royal Guard's Bow]], and the [[Royal Guard's Shield]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} The [[Sheikah]] used [[Ancient Technology]] to forge them. They were initially designed to help defend against the [[Great Calamity]], but they found little use due to their low durability. All Royal Guard's Claymores are found in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. They can be found in [[Lockup]] and the [[Guards' Chamber]]. When [[Link]] speaks to [[Parcy]] at [[Riverside Stable]], she will tell him about the equipment belonging to the [[Royal Guard]]s inside Hyrule Castle, and she laments that she could not find all of it.{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago. I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures. Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}} This will give Link "[[The Royal Guard's Gear]]" [[Side Quest]]. A Royal Guard's Claymore can be turned in for this quest in exchange for a [[Gold Rupee]].{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that big sword you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} Afterwards, Parcy will give Link a [[Topaz]] if he keeps bringing her Royal Guard's Claymores.{{Cite|Hey, that big sword... Will you trade it for a topaz?|Parcy|BotW}} Royal Guard's Claymores are made of metal, which means they will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They also can not burn near a [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]], and they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. However, they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_047" |Life = 15 |Power = 72 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 14 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 26 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 27 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 44 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 35 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 100 |BuyingPrice = 120 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 32 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Guard's Claymore}} {{Stub|TotK}} Royal Guard's Claymores reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Royal Guard’s Claymore is a [[Weapon]] [[Link]] can use in {{AoC}}. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * Royal Guard's Claymores are one of the few [[Weapon]]s stronger than the upgraded [[Master Sword]], the others being the [[Ancient Battle Axe++]] and the [[Savage Lynel Crusher]]. * A [[Glitches in Breath of the Wild|glitch]] allowing for the obtaining of infinite [[Topaz]]es can occur when [[Parcy]] takes the Royal Guard's Claymore, but it remains within the inventory.
